clips.title: The story
paras: Call of Fire is a quest in which adventurers are tasked by Olariaan Swiftburn to locate and confront the ancient forest sprite Kuramaa in the Shen'dar Highlands. By invoking the sprite from its stump and defeating it with flame, travelers obtain its powerful wooden mask. The relic is then brought to the Gustberry Lowlands to ignite an eternal flame and commune with the spirits of fire.

In the Shen'dar Highlands, local residents whisper tales of Kuramaa, an ancient forest sprite that resides inside a twisted tree stump at the summit of a hill near the regional Anchor Pylon. To draw the reclusive entity into the open, a challenger must strike the bark of its wooden home with a bare fist, demanding its presence and testing their mettle in combat.

Overcoming Kuramaa is no simple task for wielders of the arcane or divine, as the sprite possesses deep natural wards against most forms of magic. Only searing flame can pierce its ancient bark and bring it low. Defeating the creature yields Kuramaa's wooden mask, an artifact imbued with great power. Even so, Kuramaa is eternal, bound to reform and manifest again when called upon.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The residents of the Shen'dar Highlands speak of an ancient forest sprite called Kuramaa. They say it lives inside of a twisted stump at the summit of a hill near the highlands Anchor Pylon.
Go to the highlands and find this stump. Rap your fist upon the bark and Kuramaa will appear. Best the spirit in combat, and bring me its wooden mask.
Be warned however, this entity will be exceptionally resistant to much of your magic. Only the touch of flame will lay low the spirit.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The spirit of Kuramaa is eternal, and it will manifest again when it is needed. Its mask is a source of great power, and will prove invaluable to the ritual we must complete.

clips.title: Completion
paras: We now have what we need. We will light the eternal flame and commune with the spirits of fire.
